column9: Los Alamos Public Schools serves ~3,500 students; specific 1:1 device launch year not documented in public sources. District uses iPads/Apple devices per high school handbook.
Wa-Nee had 1:1 technology in all middle and high school Language Arts classes per district communications around 2014-2015; full district 1:1 launch year not pinned more precisely.
Pittston Area SD has 1:1 Chromebook initiative documented on district website with comprehensive policies; specific launch year not pinned.
Greene County NC schools provide Chromebooks to grades 7-12 take-home and K-5 classroom 1:1; specific launch year not pinned but program established by 2020.
Whitesboro CSD configures district-issued Chromebooks for student use through ClassLink; specific launch year not pinned.

Winona Area Public Schools rolled out student technology devices over four years beginning January 2016 as part of the TL21 program. Grades 3-12 received Chromebooks 1:1; K-2 used iPad classroom sets.
Albert Lea school district purchased Chromebook laptops for student use in 2017-18 school year; by 2022 third through 12th graders had Chromebooks.
Sterling CUSD 5 (Sterling Public Schools, IL) - district has technology programs but specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Mattoon CUSD 2 has technology department and student device policies; specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Ben Hill County Schools provide Google Chromebooks and iPads to students; specific 1:1 launch year not pinned but program in place.
Fairfax Elementary School District in Bakersfield serves K-8 students; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Sheridan County SCSD2 uses Dell Chromebooks district-wide; high school students repair them in computer science classes. Repair classes began ~2010 indicating long-running device program.
LCM CISD supports 1,700+ computers and high-speed network; technology FAQs page references student devices. Specific 1:1 launch year not pinned.
Nettleton SD has 5,200+ iPads and 1,000 MacBooks/iMacs district-wide indicating 1:1 program; specific launch year not pinned.
Beebe Elementary received donated Chromebooks in 2019 and additional units in 2020 from Fidelity Communications during COVID; full 1:1 reached during pandemic.
Fort Payne City Schools has 1-to-1 Chromebook knowledge base/program documented; specific launch year not pinned.
Athens City Schools' PowerUP Program is a 1:1 Apple device initiative that began in August 2015; district maintains ~3,624 MacBooks and 2,295 iPads.
DeForest Area School District serves 4,153 students PK-12; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Waynesboro City Public Schools (VA) - district has technology department; specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Burnet CISD board approved $1.4M maintenance tax note February 2020 to fund districtwide 1:1 Chromebook initiative starting 2020 for high school students.
Southern York County School District had 1:1 Chromebook program K-12; in 2025 announced scaling back to 2:1 in K-4 indicating prior K-4 1:1 program was established; launch year not pinned.
New Castle Area SD (Lawrence County, PA) - 2,951 students; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
North Bend SD 13 (Oregon) - district has technology department; specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Ashland City Schools approved 1:1 Chromebook program for high school students starting 2023-24 school year; treated like textbooks returned at end of year.
Whiteville City Schools (NC) - small district in Columbus County; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.

Moriarty-Edgewood SD recognized in April 2017 as Google for Education Reference District (first in NM) for use of G Suite and Chromebooks driving learning outcomes - implies 1:1 program well-established by then.
Milan Area Schools offers all students in grades 6-12 a Chromebook to support learning under MMS 1:1 program; specific launch year not pinned.
Godwin Heights Public Schools (Wyoming, MI) - K-12 district; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Dodge County Schools (Eastman, GA) has technology department with Chromebook support; specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Washington County (AL) Schools 1:1 Chromebook initiative covers 7-12 take-home and 3-6 classroom; specific launch year not pinned.
Centralia SD (WA) provides Chromebooks to registered students with scheduled pickup times; specific 1:1 launch year not pinned.
Robstown ISD has student device program; specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Abbeville County School District 60 (SC) - 9 schools, 2,802 students; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Guthrie Public Schools provides Chromebooks on case-by-case basis (checkout) rather than full 1:1 per district website; not full per-student 1:1.
Roslyn UFSD began issuing iPads to high school students in 2013 - first on Long Island to issue 1:1 device. In 2018 began exploring Chromebooks as iPad replacements.
Bloomfield School District (NM) has 1:1 Chromebook Device program for grades 1-12; specific launch year not pinned in publicly available sources.

School District of University City had 1:1 Chromebook initiative for high school documented in U-Times student paper; district distributed Chromebooks during March 2020 closures. Specific original launch year not pinned.
Morgan County Charter Schools (GA) implemented one-to-one technology program issuing Chromebooks to each student; specific launch year not pinned.
Hortonville Area SD has 1:1 Chromebook initiative documented in middle school handbook; specific launch year not pinned.
South Sanpete School District (Manti, UT) - 8 schools, 3,295 students PK-12; specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Lampasas High School provides every student with a Chromebook; specific district-wide 1:1 launch year not pinned.
North Providence Public Schools provides Chromebooks for student learning per Distance Learning Plan; specific 1:1 launch year not pinned.
Greater Johnstown SD long-range tech plan: grades 5-12 take Chromebook home daily, grades PK-4 assigned classroom Chromebooks. Specific launch year not pinned.
Sweet Home CSD (Amherst, NY) is Apple & Google designated school with laptop & iPad for each teacher; specific student 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
Eastchester UFSD assigns Chromebooks individually to grades 4-8 and 9-12 for use in school and at home; K-3 use classroom Chromebooks. Specific launch year not pinned.
Bernalillo Public Schools (NM) - 11 schools, 2,852 students; new innovative learning space unveiled at middle school. Specific 1:1 launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
North Plainfield Borough School District (NJ) - specific 1:1 device program launch year not documented in publicly available sources.
East Lansing Public Schools issues Chromebooks to students for class assignments per parent reports; specific 1:1 launch year not pinned.
Pentucket Regional School District announced 1:1 take-home Chromebook initiative for 2020-2021 school year.
RSU 57/MSAD 57 Maine - participates in MLTI (Maine Learning Technology Initiative) which provides 1:1 devices statewide; specific district adoption year not documented in publicly available sources.
